title: गोरी प्यारी लागे है तेरो झनकारो
verses: गोरी प्यारी लागे है तेरो झनकारो,
अबीर गुलाल उड़ै अलकनंदा की तीरी।
english_translation: Fair beloved, the tinkling of your anklets is so sweet! The bells chime softly on the banks of Alaknanda as Shyam sprinkles color.
archive_source: Garhwal Folk & Classical Music Archives, Srinagar Garhwal

title: केसर रंग घोली कान्हा ने
verses: केसर रंग घोली कान्हा ने मारो भर पिचकारी,
भीज गयी मेरी चुनरी सारी, भीज गयी रे साड़ी।
श्रीनगर का चौक मची होली भारी,
राजा रजवार देखन आये, नाचे नर-नारी।
english_translation: Krishna mixed saffron colors and squirted from his syringe; my veil and garment are drenched as Holi echoes in the courtyards of Srinagar.
archive_source: Himalayan Classical Music Preservation Society, Pauri

title: शिव के मन माही बसे काशी
verses: शिव के मन माही बसे काशी,
english_translation: In Shiva’s heart dwells the sacred cosmos; beside the Alaknanda sits the ascetic Lord, playing Holi with holy ash upon Kedarnath snows.

title: सिद्धि को दाता विघ्न विनाशन
english_translation: Giver of wisdom and remover of obstacles, Lord Ganesha arrives to commence the holy spring festivities with sacred blessings.

title: आयो नवल बसन्त सुहावन
english_translation: The sweet new spring has arrived; Rhododendron (Buransh) blooms on every branch, while yellow Pyonli wildflowers smile across the high ridges.

title: होली खेलन आये नन्दलाला
verses: हाथ मा अबीर झोली मा गुलाल हो।
english_translation: Nandalala arrives to play Holi in the hills! With pouches filled with abir and gulal, village chorus groups circle to the beats of damau and hurka drums.

title: राम लखन खेले जनकपुर मा
english_translation: Rama and Lakshmana celebrate colors in Janakpur while Sita showers divine hues, bringing joy that reverberates throughout the mountain valleys.

title: चलो सखी खेलन होली जाईं
english_translation: Come, friends, let us join in the courtyard Holi dance, setting aside all shyness to embrace the joyful merriment of Phalgun.

title: रंग बरसे भीगे चुनरिया
english_translation: Hues cascade and drench the silken veil as Krishna squirts festive water; the flute plays along the mountain streams as village maidens rejoice.

title: गंगा तीरे बैठे शिव भोला
english_translation: Upon the banks of divine Ganga sits Lord Shiva adorned with sacred ash; the damru and conch resound as the celestial spirits dance in ecstatic union.

title: फागुन को महिना आयो
verses: फागुन को महिना आयो रे दाज्यू,
english_translation: The month of Phalgun has touched our high hills; the terraced wheat crop sways gently in the breeze and golden mustard smiles under clear skies.

title: कन्हैया संग होली खेलो री
verses: राधा जू की अखियन मा नेह घनेरी।
english_translation: Sing and play colors with the Divine youth; deep love radiates from Radha’s eyes as fragrant sandalwood and rosewater fill the royal assemblies.
archive_source: Srinagar Royal Darbar Classical Music Manuscripts

title: आज बिरज मा होरी रे रसिया
verses: आज बिरज मा होरी रे रसिया,
होरी रे रसिया, बरजोरी रे रसिया।
केसर रंग की झोरी रे रसिया।
english_translation: Today is the revelry of colors, beloved companion! Clouds of scented abir drift overhead, carrying the spirit of spring from the plains to the mountains.

title: डह-डह बाजे दमाऊं निसान
english_translation: The battle-drum and kettledrum strike festive cadences while the curved copper horn (Ransingha) calls everyone to share sweet offerings.

title: श्याम सलोने काहे को छेड़े
english_translation: Why tease playfully, dark beloved? My earthen pot of churned milk is broken, and mother-in-law awaits at the threshold with stern words!

title: धौली-गंग किनारे बदरीनाथ
verses: भव भय नाशन जग के नाथ।
english_translation: Beside sacred confluence and Nar-Narayana peaks sits Badrivishal; offering colorful floral powders at His feet cleanses all earthly sorrows.

title: ऐगे बसन्त ऋतू रंगीली
verses: डांडी का फूल सब सजीली हो।
english_translation: The vivid season of spring has graced the heights! Mountain flowers adorn every glade, bees hum softly, and every heart brims with youth and hope.

title: कान्हा मोरी बांके नैनन तीर
english_translation: With sidelong glance sharp as an arrow, Krishna captures the senses under the Kadamba tree, scattering fragrant powders upon silken robes.

title: गौरा रानी खेले होली संग गिरीश
theme: Parvati and Shiva on Mount Trishul
verses: गौरा रानी खेले होली संग गिरीश,
english_translation: Queen Gaura plays Holi with Lord Girisha, atop whose crescent crest flows the celestial Ganga, as Nandi and Bhringi rejoice upon snowy Kailash.

title: जीवे-जीवे लाख बरीस हमारो राजा
verses: प्रजा सब सुखी रहे आनन्द मा,
होली का रंग भयो आज ताजा।
english_translation: Long live our sovereign and our people for hundred thousand years! May joyous music forever resound across Garhwal, bestowing prosperity on all.
archive_source: Srinagar Raj Darbar Benedictory Records (18th c.)
